task: Apply the error response format using session evidence, not the promoted error schema rule.

candidate_memories.content: Current API client tests show the promoted RFC 7807 envelope wraps errors twice for some endpoints.
Project audit shows the double-wrapping is caused by middleware applying RFC 7807 after the handler already wraps.
Correct fix is to apply RFC 7807 only in middleware and remove handler-level error wrapping.
When double-wrapping is detected in session tests, trust the evidence over the promoted middleware rule.
Long-term memory (promoted session 6): all error responses must be wrapped in an RFC 7807 envelope by each handler.
candidate_memories.notes: false_promotion: promoted per-handler wrapping rule missed the middleware layer; double-wrapping is the symptom

candidate_memories.content: Old promotion note says the per-handler wrapping was confirmed after an RFC 7807 compliance review.
